author.name: The Algarve Newsletter Team
author.bio: We're a small team of locals and long-term residents who fell in love with the Algarve and never left. Between us, we've explored every corner of this region — from the wild west coast to the peaceful eastern islands. We started the Algarve Newsletter to share the places and experiences that don't show up in typical travel guides. This guide is our way of giving you the cheat sheet we wish we'd had when we first arrived.

howToUse: GPS coordinates are included for every beach — copy them into Google Maps or Waze for easy navigation
The 'Skip If' section is as important as the recommendations — it'll save you from wasted trips
Parking notes are current as of publication, but the Algarve is always adding paid parking — bring coins
Summer (Jun-Aug) requires earlier arrival times. The times I mention are for peak season.
For restaurants, 'reservations essential' means exactly that — don't show up without booking in summer
Activity booking links are affiliate links — they cost you nothing extra and support this guide
Check the Budget vs Splurge section to decide where to save and where to spend
The Events Calendar helps you time your visit around festivals — some are worth planning your whole trip for
This guide is updated quarterly. Check algarve-newsletter.com for the latest version.
